GCMB.description: General Camber Control (GCMB). A single-key (Civil-only) record whose GCMB_BASE_ITEMS list pairs each structure group with a camber reference direction; bSTART_PT_ZERO controls whether the camber starts from zero at the start point.

bSTART_PT_ZERO.description: Whether the camber starts from zero at the start point. Optional; defaults to true.

GCMB_BASE_ITEMS.description: List of general camber base entries; each entry binds one structure group to a camber reference direction.

GRUP_NAME.description: Structure group name the camber applies to.

DIRECTION.description: Camber reference direction (case-insensitive). Hard-enforced against the enum; an invalid value is rejected by the handler.
